value.title: Docs in the pij CLI: the first pages
value.summary: PRD 009 workstream step s03 (req-05). `pij docs` gains `concepts` (the skill's concepts page, bundled), `types` and one `types/<type>` page per seat type (generated from the type catalog compiled into the daemon), and `building-a-role`. Each page names the sources it was built from, and the bundled-docs check compares each with its file.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: PRD 006 compiled the ten type definitions and seeds into the daemon (`templates/types/<type>/v<N>/`). A hand-written page per type would be a second copy, so the type pages are rendered from the catalog when pij-rs runs: always the binary's own types. Pages are now file pages (any repository file, so the skill's concepts page is bundled rather than copied) or generated pages; each carries its sources as compiled in. `docs get --json` returns them (a file's text, or a parsed document), and plan 239's check compares text byte for byte and documents as parsed JSON, so an edited type definition fails `harness checks` until pij-rs is rebuilt.

sections.name: goals
value: A seat in any repo reads what a seat, role, type, position, pod, seed and template are, and every type's definition, from pij.
One copy of each page: the skill's concepts page and the type catalog are the sources, never duplicated.

sections.name: non_goals
value: The pods page: it waits on workstream 008 step s02.
Refusals and first turns naming pages (step s04, after workstream 007 step s02).
A repo's own seeds in the type pages: those are governance (`pij directory types <type> --seed`), which docs never reads.

value.claim: `pij docs list` names agents-start-here, concepts, types, types/<type> for each of the ten, and building-a-role.

`concepts` is `skills/pij/references/community/concepts.md`, bundled: it defines seat, role, type, position, pod, seed and template, says a type is a label and never authority, separates governance (the team) from the repo (the work), and gives a build fleet and an operating fleet as examples.

`types` and `types/<type>` are rendered from `pij_daemon::community::types` (`listing()`, `all()`, `TypeDef::show()` and the shipped seed field), never from governance: line, authority, purpose, lifecycle, keeps, required fields with their flags, rules with fixed or default, the shipped seed and the source paths.

`docs get --json` returns each page's sources as compiled in (`{path, text}` or `{path, document}`); `docs list --json` names them. The bundled-docs check compares every source with its file (text byte for byte, documents as parsed JSON) and fails naming the page.

value.title: First pages shipped
value.brief: One PR (#348): sources per page, the generated type pages, concepts and building-a-role, the check's source comparison.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Blueprint 005 c-type-catalog (`crates/daemon/src/community/types.rs`) compiles each `type.dd.json` and `seed.md` with `include_bytes!`/`include_str!` and parses them once (`all()`); `TypeDef` keeps the parsed `document` and the `seed` text, so a page can carry both as sources without a file read. Blueprint 005 c-docs names the concepts page in `skills/pij/references/community/`; pm-001 assigned it to this step so it has one writer.

value.risk: A new type version ships and a page still names the old path.
value.mitigation: Paths come from each TypeDef's version, and the check compares the file at that path.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: no loop, poll, timer, hook or launch. Pages are rendered in-process from bytes already in the binary, once per call; nothing reads governance or contacts the daemon. The check adds one `docs get` per new page (fourteen in all) inside `harness checks` only.
Pages are public-safe: no customer or person names.
